question: Number of unique users in last 24h
gold_sql: SELECT uniq(user_id) FROM analytics.events WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY;

question: Top 10 event types by volume
gold_sql: SELECT event_name, count() AS n FROM analytics.events GROUP BY event_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Events per minute over last hour
gold_sql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) AS minute, count() FROM analytics.events WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute;

question: Funnel: signup → onboard → purchase
gold_sql: SELECT countIf(event_name='signup') AS s, countIf(event_name='onboard') AS o, countIf(event_name='purchase') AS p FROM analytics.events WHERE ts >= today() - 30;

question: User retention: cohort by week
gold_sql: SELECT toMonday(min(ts)) AS cohort, uniq(user_id) FROM analytics.events GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY cohort;

question: P95 of session duration
gold_sql: SELECT quantile(0.95)(session_duration_ms) FROM analytics.events WHERE event_name = 'session_end';

question: Top 5 referrers driving conversions
gold_sql: SELECT referrer, countIf(event_name='purchase') AS conversions FROM analytics.events GROUP BY referrer ORDER BY conversions DESC LIMIT 5;
